access.credential: Meta developer app and a user access token (not configured)
access.approval: Meta asks Ad Library API users to confirm their identity and location, but the onboarding page (facebook.com/ads/library/api) refused our fetcher with HTTP 403, so the exact steps are unverified
access.cost: No fee found in the pages read (unverified)

regions: EU and associated territories: ads on all topics
Worldwide: only ads about social issues, elections or politics
coverage.adTypes: ad_type ALL, EMPLOYMENT_ADS, FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_AND_SERVICES_ADS, HOUSING_ADS or POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS. 'Ads that did not reach any location in the EU will only return if they are about social issues, elections or politics'
coverage.history: EU-delivered ads: archived for one year after the last impression. Political and issue ads: kept 7 years

publishedMetrics.scope: Political and issue ads only (for example 100-499 or 1K-5K), with currency
EU and UK ads, and political ads in Brazil

dataUse: ad_snapshot_url shows the ad's images and videos. Meta: 'you must comply with the data storage terms in our Terms of Service'.
We could not read a separate terms page for the Ad Library API. A legal review is needed before ad copy is stored at scale.
unverified: The exact identity-confirmation and token steps (facebook.com/ads/library/api returned HTTP 403).
Rate limits: error 613 is documented, but no numbers are published in the pages read.
Whether search_page_ids returns a non-EU advertiser's commercial ads. The docs imply it does not: only EU-delivered or political ads are returned.

sources.note: HTTP 403 to our fetcher; not read

decisionForProductOwner: Worth a PoC only if competitors advertise in the EU or run political or issue ads. It needs a Meta developer app and identity confirmation by the account owner, then a token in .env. Spend is never available for commercial ads.
